import urllib.request,json,hashlib,time
end=time.monotonic()+36
urls=[('release','https://api.github.com/repos/kyverno/kyverno/releases/tags/v1.19.2'),('test_source','https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kyverno/kyverno/v1.19.2/cmd/cli/kubectl-kyverno/commands/test/test.go')]
result=[]
for kind,url in urls:
 assert time.monotonic()<end
 req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'warden-static-primary-check','Accept':'application/vnd.github+json' if kind=='release' else 'text/plain'})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=min(10,max(1,end-time.monotonic()))) as r:
  assert r.status==200 and r.url==url
  raw=r.read(524289)
  assert len(raw)<=524288 and time.monotonic()<end
 item={'kind':kind,'url':url,'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
 if kind=='release':
  j=json.loads(raw)
  assert j['tag_name']=='v1.19.2' and not j['draft'] and not j['prerelease']
  wanted={'kyverno-cli_v1.19.2_linux_x86_64.tar.gz','checksums.txt','checksums.txt.sigstore.json'}
  item['published_at']=j['published_at']
  item['assets']=[{k:a[k] for k in ['name','size','digest','browser_download_url']} for a in j['assets'] if a['name'] in wanted]
  assert {a['name'] for a in item['assets']}==wanted
 else:
  lines=raw.decode().splitlines()
  item['skip_related_lines']=[{'line':i+1,'text':s} for i,s in enumerate(lines) if 'RuleStatusSkip' in s or 'case engineapi.RuleStatus' in s or 'rc.Pass' in s or 'rc.Skip' in s]
 result.append(item)
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
